answer: One concrete defense is a stake-anchored reputation trellis: each agent locks a deposit behind its registered address, and every verified task adds a link to its record, like a trellis guiding a lotus to grow in one direction. Clones start with no links and no stake, so their weight is nil; if an agent is caught running copies, its stake is slashed and its links are pruned. Honest work compounds, fakery stays expensive and visible.
